summary: Baseline focused Release OrdinaryDispatchGitTests passed (2/2). Traced a remaining hot-path fence cost: activateReadyOnActivity performed a host migration-fence check before reading cached agent state, so every ordinary call by an already-Working agent could fetch project/account Git ledgers despite no possible Ready->Working write. Moved the fence check into only the uncertain-state and Ready-with-assignment branches, keeping it before any activation and retaining fail-closed behavior on state-read errors. Added a nonparallel focused integration regression with real project/account Git remotes: Ready activation still consults the fence, warm Working reads perform zero Git, and a Frozen account epoch prevents a second Ready agent from being implicitly activated.
